brief: Make this batch Kaspa-centric: there is a lot of Kaspa content in this stream (KCC20 / Nacho migration, Kaspa chart vs early Bitcoin, Kaspa's first bear market and the 50 week MA, the 3.33 dollar target and 100 trillion crypto market cap, GHOSTDAG / blockDAG lanes, Bitcoin maxis moving to Kaspa, the Kaspa conference cruise), so favor Kaspa clips over everything else.
